description.value:
A quick social read — detect a lie, a threat, or an ulterior motive before it plays out.

Attempt a single Perception check against the Deception or Deceptive-appearance DC of every creature you can see within 30 feet. On a success against a creature, you learn one of the following about it, your choice: whether it is lying to you right now, whether it intends violence within the next minute, or whether it wants something from you it has not stated.
